plain_text:
About 24 years ago, Amy Purdy
lost her legs, spleen, and
hearing in one ear from a
deadly blood infection.
Since then, she has won
three Paralympic medals for
snowboarding, advanced to
the final round on Dancing
with the Stars , and wrote
the bestselling book
On My Own Two Feet:
From Losing My Legs to
Learning the Dance of Life .
She spoke with NIH MedlinePlus
Magazine about her life's journey,
using prosthetics, and her advice
to others.
